# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Aug 11, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
August 11, 2026, saw significant stabilization and infrastructure hardening for the ElizaOS framework. Key efforts focused on optimizing cloud agent lifecycle management, improving CI/CD reliability, and refining voice/media integration. The team successfully promoted `develop` to `main` multiple times to ensure production stability while addressing critical bugs in Discord onboarding, agent pairing, and resource management.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

**Cloud Infrastructure & Agent Lifecycle**
*   Increased the node-autoscaler ceiling to 14 to support launch-chain requirements ([#18351](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18351)).
*   Restored managed dedicated-agent pairing sessions and fixed credential-boundary issues ([#18305](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18305)).
*   Implemented direct routing for Cloud agent creation and improved warm-pool replenishment budgets ([#18362](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18362), [#18364](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18364)).
*   Resolved issues with empty agent inventory termination and registry artifact hosting ([#18137](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18137), [#18350](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18350)).

**Voice, Media, and Core Agent Logic**
*   Integrated iOS system voice launches with Cartesia and ensured proper teardown of realtime sessions ([#18318](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18318), [#18376](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18376)).
*   Hardened on-demand transcription and fixed media-store URL routing ([#18429](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18429), [#18348](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18348)).
*   Fixed Discord DM lane access and excluded internal scratch worlds from inbox scans ([#18419](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18419), [#18422](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18422)).
*   Disabled DeepSeek V4 Flash thinking for forced tools to maintain compatibility ([#18400](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18400)).

**CI/CD and Testing Improvements**
*   Pinned fork pull requests to GitHub-hosted runners to resolve CI bottlenecks ([#18440](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18440)).
*   Restored managed dedicated canary in live smoke tests and preserved Pages artifacts across reruns ([#18157](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18157), [#18215](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18215)).
*   Added regression tests for Cloud lifecycle and smoke bootstrap ([#18393](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18393), [#18140](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18140)).
